patch_notes: The Watched Games list now has an Add game button: give any game a name and its process names (comma separated) and HeatWatch watches it like the built-in games. Custom games can be removed again with the × on their row; the five built-in games stay put. New test round 18 covers adding, duplicates, and removing; all 18 rounds pass.
